description: This file defines template classes and functions for binding C++ STL data types (like vector and map) to Python using pybind11. It includes type trait helpers, operator overloads, and buffer protocol support for STL containers.

classes.name: container_traits
classes.description: Helper struct to determine properties of STL containers, such as comparability, pairing, and vector-like traits.

classes.name: is_comparable
classes.description: Type trait to check if a container or type supports comparison operators.

classes.name: KeysViewImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a view over map keys, providing size, iteration, and containment checks.

classes.name: ValuesViewImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a view over map values, providing size and iteration.

classes.name: ItemsViewImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a view over map items (key-value pairs), providing size and iteration.

methods.name: vector_if_copy_constructible
methods.description: Defines copy constructor for vectors if the type supports it.

methods.name: vector_if_equal_operator
methods.description: Defines comparison operators and related methods for vectors if the type supports comparison.

methods.name: vector_modifiers
methods.description: Adds list modification methods (append, extend, insert, pop, etc.) to vectors if the value type supports copy construction.

methods.name: vector_accessor
methods.description: Defines element access and iteration methods for vectors, handling both copyable and non-copyable element types.

methods.name: vector_has_data_and_format
methods.description: SFINAE trait to check if a vector type supports data() and format descriptor for buffer protocol.

methods.name: vector_buffer_impl
methods.description: Adds buffer protocol support to vectors if supported.

methods.name: bind_vector
methods.description: Function template to expose std::vector to Python, including constructors, buffer protocol, comparison, and list operations.

methods.name: map_if_insertion_operator
methods.description: Defines __repr__ for map types if insertion operator is supported.

methods.name: map_assignment
methods.description: Defines __setitem__ for maps if the mapped type supports copy assignment or copy construction.

methods.name: format_message_key_error
methods.description: Formats error messages for missing map keys, truncating long messages.

methods.name: bind_map
methods.description: Function template to expose std::map and std::unordered_map to Python, including iteration, key/value views, and item access.
